filing_office: Nevada Secretary of State, Commercial Recordings
filing_fee_notes: The SOS identifies Articles of Organization, an Initial List and a State Business License as formation filings. Their current combined cost could not be verified from accessible permitted sources.
registered_agent_rules: The SOS permits a noncommercial agent with a physical Nevada address, subject to its entity-count limit, or designation of an office or position within an entity with a Nevada physical address.
annual_report_name: Annual List of Managers or Members / Business License Application
unemployment_insurance_agency: Nevada Department of Employment, Training and Rehabilitation, Employment Security Division
plain_english_summary: The SOS lists Articles of Organization, an Initial List and a State Business License for formation. It also provides annual list and license filings.
common_mistake: Do not budget for Articles of Organization alone.
notes: Scope: ordinary domestic LLC. SOS pages were available mainly through official indexed text; direct pages and fee documents encountered access controls. Formation fee, name reservation fee, annual list fee and deadline were therefore left null. Name-search URL, explicit registered-agent mandate, standard processing time, expedite terms, franchise or privilege tax treatment, publication requirements and operating-agreement mandate were not confirmed. Filing URLs are official gateways.
